Karthik / Laura — see inline and attached. I completed the DPQ worksheet and prepared a tracked DPA annex redline. Summary of key points for NovusCare:

- Transfer mechanism: Redwood will rely on EU Commission Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs - Module Two/Controller-Processor where applicable) for transfers from the EEA to the U.S., supplemented by organizational and technical measures. We reference SCCs executed via our DPA annex.

- Supplementary measures: Encryption of data in transit (TLS 1.2+), at-rest encryption with customer-specific envelope encryption supported via KMS (we support customer-managed keys for Private deployments), strict access controls, periodic pen-tests, and contractual obligations on subprocessors.

- Data categories: We marked "Contact & scheduling PII" as the primary category; no special category health data is processed by our hosted API by default, but customers may transmit limited health-adjacent metadata. We call this out and propose a contract clause restricting processing of Special Category Health Data unless explicitly agreed.

- Subprocessors: Attached spreadsheet includes our current subprocessors list (storage providers, monitoring, telemetry processors). For NovusCare, we can commit to 30 days notice for new subprocessors and provide an updated list upon signing.

- Retention & deletion: Default logs retention is 30 days for request logs; API request/response payloads are not stored persistently in hosted mode beyond ephemeral caches unless customer opts into longer retention (we documented options in the DPQ cells). We propose retention language matching their PDP requirements; see redline.

- Data subject rights & audit: We support DSAR workflows and will cooperate with lawful requests; audit rights are scoped to SOC 2 evidence + redacted logs unless on Dedicated/Private where additional audit options apply (we noted that in the annex).

I've attached the completed workbook (NovusCare_DPF_Responses_v1.xlsx) and a tracked DPA annex (DPA_Annex_Redwood_v2.docx). Also included a link to our security package (internal) and SOC 2 report (restricted link).

Proposed next steps for external:
1) Send completed DPQ and tracked DPA to Priya with summary bullets and the security package link.
2) Offer a 30-min walkthrough to address any flagged items (especially around what constitutes 'health data').
